briefings.title: BREAKING NEWS: Trump, Mark Zuckerberg, Dario Amodei, And More Discuss New AI Standards Accords
briefings.tldr: President Trump and top tech leaders announced the formal signing of the "White House Accord on Super Intelligence," officially rebranding AI to SI (super intelligence) and committing to voluntary internal controls, multi-layered audits, and community partnerships to maintain U.S. dominance over China while driving historic economic growth.

briefings.title: CHM Live | Anthropic's Boris Cherny, Creator of Claude Code
briefings.tldr: Boris Cherny, creator of Claude Code at Anthropic, discusses the exponential trajectory of AI coding agents, shifting industry paradigms from deterministic programming to empirical model discovery, and the critical role of safety and alignment research.

briefings.title: AI CEOs Brief the U.N. Security Council
briefings.tldr: AI CEOs and UN Security Council members debated the acute risks of frontier AI systems—including autonomous cyberattacks, loss of human control, and bioweapons proliferation—while dividing sharply over whether to establish binding international regulatory frameworks or rely on sovereign tech adoption and permissionless innovation.

briefings.title: Why Dario Amodei and Sam Altman Are Faking the AI Doomsday Crisis | The Weekly Wrap
briefings.tldr: Steve Eisman breaks down why Dario Amodei and Sam Altman’s AI extinction warnings are a strategic shell game to invite regulation and build pricing moats, while also covering rate hikes, his FICO short, and portfolio diversification away from AI.

briefings.title: Extended interview: Trump AI adviser David Sacks on tech leaders' AI fears
briefings.tldr: David Sacks, presidential AI adviser, dismisses fears of AI-induced human extinction as an overblown political panic, arguing that frontier AI labs must take responsibility for product safety rather than seeking antitrust waivers or halting development, which would hand a decisive advantage to China.

briefings.title: Jensen Huang, Dario Amodei and Siemens CEO Busch Debate AI’s Future at Dreamforce 2026 | AI1G
briefings.tldr: At Dreamforce 2026, technology leaders from Salesforce, Anthropic, Nvidia, and Siemens debated AI adoption, regulation, and enterprise safety, emphasizing the shift toward agentic AI systems tightly coupled with trusted business data.

briefings.title: Nvidia's Jensen Huang Joins Marc Benioff as AI Debate Takes Center Stage at Dreamforce | AI1G
briefings.tldr: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Salesforce CEO Marc Benioff discussed the transition of enterprises into "agentic AI companies" at Dreamforce 2026, emphasizing that AI serves as a new technological layer that drives productivity and transforms every industry rather than destroying jobs.

briefings.title: Extended Interview: Dario Amodei
briefings.tldr: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei warns that AI is rapidly accelerating along an exponential curve, carrying profound benefits like curing diseases as well as severe existential and biological security risks.

briefings.title: Anthropic CEO reacts to 'AI could kill us all' warning
briefings.tldr: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei and former Anthropic insider Jacob Coxon warn that rapidly advancing AI models could pose extinction-level risks by the end of the decade due to autonomous capabilities and recursive self-improvement.

briefings.title: Commerce Sec. Lutnick and Anthropic co-founder Tom Brown speak at G20 meeting — 9/2/2026
briefings.tldr: AI capabilities and demand are scaling exponentially, driven by systematic compute and data scaling laws that require an unprecedented global industrial buildout of data centers.

briefings.title: Commerce Sec. Lutnick and Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang in a fireside chat at G20 meeting — 9/2/2026
briefings.tldr: Jensen Huang and Howard Lutnick discussed AI as the greatest platform shift in human history, framing it as physical economic infrastructure that manufactures digital intelligence (measured in tokens) akin to electricity.

briefings.title: LIVE: Commerce Sec. Howard Lutnick holds news conference at the G20 Innovation Ministerial — 9/2/26
briefings.tldr: Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnik and OSTP Director Michael Kratsios announced a unanimous G20 consensus on the Carolina principles for emerging technology during a press conference in Chapel Hill, North Carolina, emphasizing heavy private sector AI infrastructure investments and the global reach of the American AI stack.

briefings.title: Dario Defends Himself, Datacenter Panic, AI Doomer Trap, Senate Toss-Up
briefings.tldr: Tech leaders and political figures are clashing over AI regulation, data center expansion, and economic affordability, driving growing public anxiety and a cultural shift toward socialist policies.

briefings.title: Agentic AI and the Future of Software Development: S3 E4
briefings.tldr: Agentic AI is fundamentally transforming software development and organizational workflows, enabling exponential productivity gains, multi-agent orchestration, and autonomous execution.

briefings.title: Advancing AI 2026 | Build What's Next with @AMD
briefings.tldr: AMD announced its 2026 AI roadmap at the Advancing AI event, anchored by the launch of the Helios AI rack, the Venice (6th Gen EPYC) CPU family, the ROCm.ai agentic software platform, and localized hardware like Ryzen AI Halo and Kria robotics modules.

briefings.title: Anthropic's Katelyn Lesse & Angela Jiang: Building an Ecosystem, not a Walled Garden
briefings.tldr: Anthropic is shifting its platform focus from simple model access to a sophisticated three-layer stack—Knowledge, Execution, and Coordination—prioritizing open standards like the Model Context Protocol (MCP) to build a collaborative ecosystem rather than a walled garden.

briefings.title: Big Technology AI Summit (full): Greg Brockman, Mike Krieger, Aaron Levie & Friends of The Podcast
briefings.tldr: The rapid shift from conversational chatbots to autonomous, action-taking AI agents is driving a massive $700 billion infrastructure buildout, even as the industry faces severe regulatory friction, geopolitical hardware risks, and an urgent enterprise focus on measuring real ROI over hype.

briefings.title: Building the most AI-pilled engineering team in the world | Fiona Fung (Anthropic)
briefings.tldr: AI has unlocked an 8x increase in code shipping velocity at Anthropic, shifting the engineering bottleneck from writing code to verifying it.

briefings.title: Inside the Mind of Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei | The Circuit | Extended Interview
briefings.tldr: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei details his company's rapid exponential growth, its deliberate alignment of enterprise business models with safety values, and the high-stakes trade-offs of navigating national security, frontier AI risks, and severe economic disruption.

briefings.title: Inside Anthropic, the $965 Billion AI Juggernaut | The Circuit
briefings.tldr: Led by sibling founders Dario and Daniela Amodei, Anthropic has established itself as a major enterprise AI force, but its strict commitment to safety guardrails has put it on a collision course with Silicon Valley rivals and the Pentagon.

briefings.title: Anthropic President Amodei on the Future of Claude
briefings.tldr: Anthropic President Daniela Amodei highlights the company's rapid scaling—marked by $7.3 billion raised and a projected $850 million annualized revenue run rate—while outlining how strategic, multi-cloud partnerships with Amazon and Google fuel capital-intensive frontier training without compromising the startup's independent, safety-first mission.

briefings.title: Snowflake Summit 2026 Opening Keynote With Sridhar Ramaswamy And Daniela Amodei
briefings.tldr: At Snowflake Summit 2026, CEO Sridhar Ramaswamy declared the arrival of the "Agentic Enterprise," introducing Snowflake Intelligence and Cortex Code (CoCo) as secure, governance-first control planes designed to coordinate data, models, and SaaS applications to automate end-to-end business workflows.

briefings.title: Claude Code Head Boris Cherny: Insane Growth, Tokenmaxxing, AI Agents' Next Frontier
briefings.tldr: Anthropic’s Claude Code and co-work agentic products are experiencing explosive, exponential growth, shifting AI from basic conversational chatbots to autonomous agents that can control computers and use APIs.

briefings.title: The Founders of Claude AI Tell Oprah About the Impact Artificial Intelligence Has on Your Life
briefings.tldr: Anthropic co-founders Dario and Daniela Amodei emphasize that while AI represents an "epochal change" comparable to the Industrial Revolution, its development must be steered by human ethics and the "speed of trust" rather than pure commercial speed.

briefings.title: How Claude went from $9 billion to $30 billion in one year | CFO explains
briefings.tldr: Anthropic CFO Krishna Rao details the company’s explosive growth from a $9 billion to $30 billion revenue run rate in a single year, driven by a strategic "compute-first" philosophy that prioritizes staying at the technological frontier to unlock massive enterprise demand.

briefings.title: Daniela Amodei, Co-Founder and President of Anthropic: Building AI the Right Way

people.name: Gintare Zukauskaite
people.role: MBA student, Stanford Graduate School of Business

briefings.tldr: Anthropic was founded on the principle of "radical responsibility," prioritizing AI safety and integrity through a Public Benefit Corporation structure while positioning AI as a collaborative tool that enhances, rather than replaces, human judgment and social connection.

briefings.title: A conversation with Dario Amodei & Daniela Amodei
briefings.tldr: Anthropic is currently navigating "hyper-exponential" growth (80x annualized revenue/usage) that has exceeded even the founders' aggressive scaling predictions, signaling a shift toward multi-agent AI hierarchies and the potential for a one-person, billion-dollar company by 2026.

briefings.title: Anthropic's Boris Cherny: Why Coding Is Solved, and What Comes Next
briefings.tldr: Coding is effectively "solved" for standard distributions, shifting the developer's role from writing syntax to managing autonomous agent loops.

briefings.title: The AI Tsunami is Here & Society Isn't Ready | Dario Amodei x Nikhil Kamath | People by WTF
briefings.tldr: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei warns that an "AI tsunami" is approaching human-level intelligence faster than public awareness can adapt, necessitating a focus on safety, sensible regulation, and human-centric skills to navigate the transition.

briefings.title: LIVE: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei address at AI India impact summit in Delhi | AI Growth|Global South
briefings.tldr: Anthropic is establishing a major footprint in India, viewing the nation as a strategic leader for the Global South to manage the "staggering" exponential growth of AI while mitigating risks of economic disruption and model misuse.

briefings.title: Boris Cherny: How We Built Claude Code
briefings.tldr: Claude Code marks a paradigm shift where AI agents treat coding as a "practically solved" problem, yielding 150% productivity gains at Anthropic and signaling a transition from specialized "Software Engineers" to generalist "Builders" who use agent swarms to execute 100% of their code.

briefings.title: Anthropic Builder Summit Bengaluru | CEO Dario Amodei & Rahul Patil Keynote
briefings.tldr: India has emerged as Anthropic’s second-largest global user base, characterized by high technical intensity and a rapid shift from basic AI assistance to complex, agentic "thinking" software that solves large-scale societal and industrial problems.

briefings.title: Anthropic REACTS to Sam Altman's Takedown of Their Super Bowl Ads
briefings.tldr: Anthropic philosopher Amanda Askell explains "Constitutional AI," a method of instilling core values and a distinct "character" into the Claude model to prioritize truthfulness and user well-being over the engagement-driven sycophancy common in other AI models.

briefings.title: Dario Amodei — The highest-stakes financial model in history
briefings.tldr: Dario Amodei (CEO of Anthropic) argues we are 1–3 years away from "a country of geniuses in a data center" (AGI), asserting that while technical scaling remains a predictable exponential, the primary challenges have shifted to economic diffusion, the financial risk of trillion-dollar compute bets, and the geopolitical necessity of ensuring liberal democracies win the AI race.

briefings.title: Anthropic's CEO: ‘We Don’t Know if the Models Are Conscious’ | Interesting Times with Ross Douthat
briefings.tldr: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei outlines a future of radical abundance—including the eradication of major diseases and massive GDP growth—tempered by the "bloodbath" of rapid white-collar job displacement and the urgent need for "Constitutional AI" to prevent rogue autonomy.

briefings.title: The day after AGI: Two 'rock stars' of AI on what it will mean for humanity
briefings.tldr: Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) is projected to reach human-level cognitive performance as early as 2026–2027, driven by AI systems "closing the loop" to automate their own coding and research.
